values.note: All sites by reservation since May 1, 2026, up to 6 months ahead. 14 nights at most May 1-Oct 31 and 30 nights in a calendar year. Check-in and check-out noon. Group site 25 opens each year on March 1 (8 a.m. MST) on its own recreation.gov page.

values.note: In winter one loop (33 sites) is closed and the rest stay bookable; water is off from Oct 1 until about May.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251160 ('the campground is open year-round'); recreation.gov month availability 2026-11 through 2027-05 (37 sites Available, 33 Closed until 2027-05-10); water notice, read 2026-11-12

note: NPS campground in the South Unit of Theodore Roosevelt National Park, ~5 mi in from the Medora entrance, beside the Little Missouri River among cottonwoods; bison often pass through. Sites run from short back-ins to long pull-throughs. Overhanging branches may not clear rigs over 13 ft. --Claude
summary: NPS page + rec.gov: all sites reservable year-round since May 2026 (fcfs never), $20 May-Sep / $10 Oct-Apr, 73 sites (60 drive-in, 59 take 23 ft+, 12 walk-to, 1 group), no hookups/dump/showers. Every group now manual; $30 7-day entrance added; season year_round confirmed; note cleaned of the outdated first-come off-season. Pin ~320 m off.
